input.quote: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Section 11.1 sits squarely in walk-away territory: it mandates immediate cessation of all assistance and permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support, so the Agreement provides no transition-assistance period at all (Section 10.1 only assumes "any agreed transition period" without obliging Vendor to grant one). Sections 11.2 and 11.3 do supply compliant 30-day return and certified-deletion mechanics, but 11.1 directly contradicts them and, as the first-stated rule for the moment of termination, creates a material internal conflict Vendor could exploit to delete data before any return request. The clause therefore fails even the fallback (90 days of assistance plus 30-day export). The minimal fix replaces 11.1 with the preferred six-month transition-assistance obligation at Vendor's then-current rates and subordinates any deletion to the existing 11.2/11.3 sequence, leaving those compliant paragraphs untouched.

ops.oldText: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates, including migration support and export of Customer Data. Vendor shall not delete or render inaccessible any Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept immediate cessation of assistance and deletion of Customer Data with no export, which is a walk-away position for us and also contradicts Sections 11.2 and 11.3. We have replaced it with our standard exit provision: up to six months of transition assistance at your then-current rates, with deletion occurring only under the Section 11.2/11.3 return-and-certification mechanics (we can discuss a 90-day assistance period if six months is difficult).
proposal.summary: Replace immediate-deletion/no-assistance clause with 6-month transition assistance and preserve the 11.2/11.3 data-return and certified-deletion sequence.
